title: The ready-check read should name which tree it read
why: Coordinator guard candidate, low, 04:29 CST Nov 15 (relayed; unproven). On #3255 the draft step stopped with 'the ready checks of 28283425c against main are unknown, not a pass: cannot read the workflow: no workflow file in the tree has a checks-rest job'. A stale PR tree (1132 commits behind main, predating the job, per the coordinator) and a bad config read the same. Harm: a session cannot tell whether to merge main in or fix the config. Fix: the unknown line names the tree it read. Past rulings checked: none found. No existing step covered it (grep of roadmap steps, 04:30 CST).
source: coordinator 04:29 CST Nov 15, relayed by triage
